cleared_is_the_weakest_bar: `cleared_own_floor` compares the point delta to the lane's recorded rho floor and nothing else. It is not a verdict: a verdict needs the Holm correction across that lane's family, and for anything gated after 2026-09-06 the co-primary contributor-AUC leg as well. It is published because the count of arms that reached even this bar is the honest way to describe the program's yield.
reading: 392 arms have been adjudicated across 9 lanes, 351 of them scoreable against a recorded floor, and 0 reached that floor on the point estimate. At a nominal 5% per arm, pure noise alone would be expected to produce about 19.6 passes across 392 arms. Fewer arms cleared than noise alone would produce, which says the per-lane floors are, if anything, conservative, and that the program's run of nulls is a real result rather than a reporting artifact. Every lane's own Holm correction is correct and controls the error rate WITHIN that lane; nothing has ever controlled it across lanes, because until now nothing counted them. Read any survivor against this denominator.
this_is_not_a_correction: no program-wide Holm is applied and none should be. The arms were gated on different frames, pools and label definitions, so a retrospective joint family would imply a structure that never existed. The count makes the denominator visible; the reserved 2025 fold is what actually buys confirmation.

reserved_fold.rule: held out of every exploratory read so the confirmatory read has rows the exploration never touched. A survivor found and confirmed on the same rows is worth nothing.
